Bisher erhaltene Abrechnungen der Leistungserbringer und/oder deren Dienstleistern, die in Papierform eingehen, sollen durch den Auftragnehmer digitalisiert und so der Auftraggeberin zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Dadurch erleichtert sich für die Auftraggeberin die Rechnungs- bearbeitung und es wird Potenzial für Prozessoptimierungen und -automatisierungen geschaf- fen. Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. 1.1 Losbildung Eine Losbildung unterbleibt, da ein ganzheitlicher Scandienst mit der Gesamtverantwortung des künftigen Auftragnehmers ausgeschrieben wird. Ausgeschrieben wird ein Rahmenvertrag mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Bieter sind aufgefordert, ein Angebot einzureichen. 1.2 Art der Vergabe Die Auftraggeberin schreibt die benötigten Leistungen in einem offenen Verfahren im Sinne von § 15 VgV aus. Dieses Vergabeverfahren wird aus Gründen der Transparenz über eine elektronische Vergabeplattform betrieben. Die Auftraggeberin verwendet ausschließ lich die Vergabeplattform der DTVP Deutsches Vergabeportal GmbH (www.dtvp.de). Es ist das zum Zeitpunkt der Veröffentlichung der Bekanntmachung geltende Vergaberecht maßgeblich, auch, wenn dieses sich während des Vergabeverfahrens ändern sollte.   1. Description of Services

The consulting services (“the Services”) include: Task 1: Africa RISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and proc

ISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and process workflows, including a unified data interoperability Layer that meets vPIC standards and aligns with the Africa RISE Regional Geospatial Analytics Platform and national irrigation monitoring systems.  The architecture shall specify: (a) the endpoints and payload schemas through which national data collection tools, the Regional Geospatial Platform,  and other authorized external data sources submit and validate benchmarking data; (b) the data lineage and version control mechanisms ensuring that published benchmarks are traceable to their submission source; and (c) the traffic-light alert logic that translates performanc

sociated training materials for all user groups, comprising: (i) a Technical Track for AUDA-NEPAD IT personnel, national technical focal points and system administrators, covering system administration, data management, integration and cybersecurity; (ii) an Operational Track for programme managers, extension officers and policy stakeholders, focusing on effective use of the platform and its functional modules; and (iii) an End-User Track providing simplified guidance and orientation materials. Task 4: Sustainable Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Model for the Gateway: Assess the technical and operational requirements for sustained operation of the Gateway, including hosting, security, data management, updates, user support and maintenance schedules and prepare indicative annual cost projections for the post-project period. Task 5: Envisaged functionality of the Africa RISE Gateway: The Africa RISE Gateway, as a go-to information and knowledge solution, is envisaged to serve.

SCOPE OF WORK The vendor will develop and implement a creative, physical messaging campaign to publicize safe, official repatriation mechanisms in target communities across Honduras. Activities will include the design, procurement, and deployment of everyday, high-turnover physical media—such as reusable bags, food packaging, or other take-home items—to deliver messaging about repatriation mechanisms to the family members of Honduran nationals currently residing illegally in the United States. To realize this initiative, the selected organization will be responsible for building strategic relationships with private sector micro-logistics networks, small business owners, commercial brands, or community merchant associations across five Honduran cities to successfully disseminate and deploy the branded materials directly into target zones. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. C.3 SCOPE The contractor shall provide the Library with new perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses and technical support for perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses—new or legacy— in its possession. This support includes the services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons with Alexa-enabled smart-speaker devices to use a voice-only user interface to search the NLS Catalog, manage their Wishlist, access BARD Lists, and stream audio content from NLS’s Talk

My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

hall provide the Library with license and technical support. This support shall be provided on an annual basis at a firm-fixed price. This support shall be provided in blocks of 500. The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine.
